headline: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Eyes IPO Within 18 Months to Expand EV Lineup
summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility is planning an initial public offering in the next 18 months. Chairman Rajesh Jejurikar indicated the funds will support expansion across electric three- and four-wheeler cargo and passenger segments.
why: Mahindra & Mahindra is one of India's top automotive manufacturers, and its commercial unit dominates electric three-wheeler sales.

impacts.name: Mahindra & Mahindra
impacts.why: Preparing its electric commercial unit for an IPO unlocks capital for broader EV expansion.
